sections.heading: Thingamajob
sections.paragraph: Client #1 proved exception-based review: clean, directly supported facts are established automatically, routine discrepancies are resolved behind the scenes, and false-positive questions were eliminated. No human-required questions remain. Protected TEST now presents a usable résumé assembly, with provenance, correction history and diagnostics preserved behind the protected admin surface. JD evaluation and benchmark comparison have not started.

sections.heading: Public site
sections.paragraph: Home and the case study share one public Thingamajob component. Candidate-to-job outcomes are now Strong Match, Supported Match, Needs Candidate Confirmation and Match Gap. The corrected homepage layout and construction status, global texture and depth, and living-theme sun-following shadows are live. Five reviewed responsive artwork slides replaced the temporary designs; Creative Town is unchanged. AVIF/WebP delivery is live, and production returned to perfect Lighthouse scores after the visual overhaul.

sections.heading: Current focus
sections.paragraph: Keep the public visual system stable. Next: compare the independently built Client #1 truth set against the sealed benchmark. If it holds up, proceed to real JD evaluation.
